_comment: Shift Tracker process definitions. Each entry maps a display name to the PPR 'LineItem Name' base (the report breaks each into - Small/Medium/Large/Heavy/Total, EACH unit) and the necro OP2 TPH key for the vs-OP2 line. The tracker charts the '- Total' of each and can drill into sizes. lineitem_base matches the text before ' - <Size>'. op2_key is the necro_op2_daily key (empty = vs-Plan only). Hot-fixable.
